chapters.label: Sunrise
chapters.title: Power your home & business with the sun.
chapters.body: Scroll through one day on a SunRyse island, from the first light on the panels to the moment the grid goes dark.

chapters.label: Panels wake up
chapters.title: The panels wake with the sun.
chapters.body: Tier-1 panels, sized to your bill and your roof, start producing from first light. Our engineers design the layout around shade, tilt and wind.

chapters.label: The inverter
chapters.title: One box runs the whole house.
chapters.body: A hybrid, battery-ready inverter turns sunlight into the power your appliances use, charges the battery and decides what goes to the grid.

chapters.label: Selling back
chapters.title: Extra sun goes back to the grid.
chapters.body: At midday you make more than you use. With net metering, every exported kWh earns a credit on your bill. We file the paperwork for you.

chapters.label: Brownout
chapters.title: The street goes dark. You don't.
chapters.body: When the grid fails, your battery keeps the lights, fans and fridge running, quietly, for hours, while the neighbours wait for the power to come back.

chapters.label: Business & industry
chapters.title: Built for shops, offices and factories too.
chapters.body: Solar output peaks when businesses use the most power. Rooftop arrays on offices, malls and plants cut daytime power costs.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.title: Ready to rise with the sun?
chapters.body: Get your system size, all-in price and payback in two minutes, then book a free site survey.

configurator.heading: See *~your~* home on solar.
configurator.subheading: Type your monthly bill, pick your property and play the day: panels, battery and savings update as you go.
